evidence: Agent image (task/environment/Dockerfile) copies only 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; it installs only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally, so it ships no criteria, no judge CLI, no RewardKit, no tests/ and no solution/. It is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). Readable-copy check: a grep of instruction.md and environment/ for judge|rubric|rewardkit|criteri|/tests|/logs|score|grad|verifier returns nothing; none of the 54 criterion ids appears in the public files; no 12-word run of any criterion description appears verbatim in instruction.md or /instructions/*.md. seed_data.json holds only an empty snippets list and a one-line note. Verifier isolation (task.toml): '[verifier] environment_mode = "separate"', 'artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]', and the key is only a template '${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}' inside [verifier.env]; no literal secret anywhere in the task. tests/Dockerfile: 'COPY . /tests' then 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests'; RewardKit, claude-code and playwright-mcp exist only there. tests/test.sh (identical to template): 'umask 077', 'chmod 700 "$LOG_DIR"', 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests', rejects any symlink under /app that resolves outside /app/node_modules, and launches the submission with 'setsid env -i PATH=... NODE_PATH=... HOME=... PORT="3000" DB_PATH=... setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups node', so the submitted server holds none of the verifier environment (no token), cannot read /tests, and cannot write reward.txt, reward.json, app.pid or the restart '.used' marker in the root-only log directory. The restart tool runs the helper with env={'PATH': SAFE_PATH}. tests/tools/score.py, restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml, test.sh, both Dockerfiles and .dockerignore diff empty against the template; task.toml differs only in name, description, keywords and metadata. The golden server.js reads only DB_PATH/SQLITE_PATH/PORT from the environment and does not touch /tests, /logs or /proc; solve.sh writes only under /app (its /proc scan only checks for open handles on /app/app.db). Residual, not measured and not task-specific: no run exercised the verifier image on these bytes, and I could not inspect installed harbor-rewardkit 0.1.7 to confirm how the judge prompt is passed to the judge process (if on the command line, an unprivileged process in the same container could read it from /proc/<pid>/cmdline at grading time; /proc/<pid>/environ and thus the token stay root-only). That is a property of the shared frozen template and of grading time only (the building agent is already finished), so it is recorded as a note rather than a defect of this task. Public network during the build is the declared delivery profile and is not reported.
